# netgx

netgx inspects a network topology for dangling edges, public reach to sensitive
data and self-loops. Part of gxkit; the inspect contract (stable codes, exit
codes, a storyboard) is shared.

- Install/run: uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/netgx" netgx inspect net.py
- Write: a Python file building netgx.Network(nodes={"internet": "public", "db": "data"}, edges=[("internet", "web")], sensitive=["db"]); or NODES / EDGES / SENSITIVE.
- Node kinds: public, edge, service, data.
- netgx inspect net.py — exit 1 on any error; --json; --no-storyboard; -o name.png.
- Codes: no-nodes (info), dangling-edge (error), dangling-reference (error, a `sensitive` name that is not a node), public-reaches-sensitive (error), self-loop (warn), duplicate-edge (info), isolated-node (info), no-public (info).
